task: Delete admin-elevated Node/Git/CLI acquisition flow across six sync layers, add download integrity check, and expose precedence-warning via existing check_codemie inspector command.

key_reasoning.reason: 4+ components across multiple subsystems must move in sync: installer.rs + error.rs (deletion + Sudo variant prune), downloader.rs (new integrity logic), inspector.rs (handshake extension), lib.rs (deregistration), handlers.js + runner-bridge.js + renderer.js (JS layer), and two YAML step-plan files compiled into the binary — plus a new handshake-precedence abstraction surface.

Closest existing pattern is downloader.rs, which performs zero integrity verification; the security-sensitive SHA-256/size check has no reusable util in this codebase, satisfying the auto-bump rule. Additional risk: tight coupling to S1 branch EPMCDME-14573 (inject_bundled_bin_path), stale steps.rs test requiring rewrite, and InstallerError::Sudo dead-variant that will hard-fail cargo clippy -D warnings if not pruned in sync.

Approximately 10 files modified across 4 directories: config/ (steps.yaml, steps-windows.yaml), src-tauri/src/ (lib.rs, steps.rs), src-tauri/src/commands/ (installer.rs, error.rs, downloader.rs, inspector.rs), ui/ (handlers.js, runner-bridge.js, renderer.js). L boundary (8–10 modified, 3+ directories) is met.

4 distinct layers touched: Config/Infrastructure (YAML step plans compiled at build time), Service/Rust-commands (installer, downloader, inspector), External (CLI invocation via check_codemie/check_codemie_version), and UI/JS (handlers, bridge, renderer). No DB schema migration.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from L(4) to XL(5): security requirement — AC requires truncated/modified files to be rejected; closest existing pattern (downloader.rs) covers no integrity verification, making the SHA-256/size check a security-sensitive addition with no existing reusable util.
